title: About 1,000 families left homeless in Davao fire

blocks.text: DAVAO CITY — At least 1,000 families lost their homes on Thursday afternoon due to massive fire that hit a residential area in Carpenter, Purok Corias, Barangay Leon Garcia of Agdao District here. Fire Inspector Frances Marie Sendrijas said the fire was reported around 5:06 p.m. The situation immediately reached second alarm at 5:13 p.m.
